economics.same_asset_unit: USDe principal and reward; no stablecoin conversion or fiat parity is used in the scoped gross-yield claim

eligibility_and_terms.reward_distribution: automatic weekly credit to Spot Account every Monday
eligibility_and_terms.reward_distribution_time_conflict: The legal terms say by 10:00 UTC while the current product page says before 12:00 PM Monday; no exact payout-time claim is used.
eligibility_and_terms.reward_rate_control: Binance determines APR at its discretion based on market conditions and product sustainability and may update it weekly.
eligibility_and_terms.snapshot: random daily time between 00:00 and 23:59 UTC using the minimum eligible balance of the day

limitations: No account KYC jurisdiction restriction eligible balance holding duration reward history or owned weekly distribution was accessed.
USDe can deviate from its reference value and has issuer strategy counterparty custody liquidity regulatory and operational risks; same-token yield is not fiat profit or principal protection.
The current four-percent reference APR can be changed weekly or the campaign can be amended suspended or terminated without notice.
The scope credits only USDe already independently held for a separate reason. It does not authorize buying depositing converting borrowing or retaining USDe to earn the reward.
Using USDe as collateral does not prove margin efficiency liquidation safety borrowing economics or prompt liquidity and is not credited as an additional edge here.
Tax withdrawal transfer custody and opportunity costs remain account-specific and unproved.
prohibited_actions: acquiring depositing converting borrowing or retaining USDe solely for the reward
moving USDe needed for prompt settlement withdrawal or risk reduction merely to preserve a daily snapshot
counting an unproved account balance KYC jurisdiction or reward distribution
treating the four-percent reference APR as guaranteed persistent fiat return
double-counting collateral efficiency borrowing benefits or any separate Ethena yield
submitting an order transfer deposit conversion or account mutation without separate explicit authority

retry_policy.public_refresh: only after a published USDe APR eligibility account snapshot distribution or campaign-term change
signed_prequalification_only_after_both_: exact account KYC and jurisdiction eligibility
existing independently required USDe balances by eligible account and completed 24-hour duration
owned daily reward-history rows and weekly distributions at the exact applicable APR
retry_policy.separate_funded_authority_required_for: any acquisition deposit transfer conversion borrow repayment trade or other balance-changing action
